checks: Actual provider capture and matching produce ready run; independent sign service issues source-bound certificate
Missing read/export permission, expired auth, foreign tenant/actor/object and stale preview produce no export or financial effects
Inactive actor cannot issue an export
Actual signed certificate and immutable receipt retain exact UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256; receipt is embedded in file
Same request returns original bytes, receipt and timestamp despite new transport metadata; no repeat issuance audit/event
Another actor cannot reuse request identity; intentional new request has separate receipt and preserves prior evidence
Malformed or modified retained export is refused on retry
Late issuance audit failure rolls back the receipt and retained bytes
Concurrent duplicate submission issues one durable receipt and can replay safely
Suspended provider does not prevent authorized retained signed-evidence retrieval
Certificate tampering and changed source amount block even replay; restored evidence reuses original file
scope: Owned synthetic provider setup/internal payment; actual HMAC capture, matching, independent sign service and export. No external provider, payment or statutory approval.
